steps.text: 3:56 P.M. \ Overcast
Main District of Trimounts

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: This is the third time you've paged through Ptilopsis's personal log, Doctor.

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: Any new discoveries?

options: Ptilopsis keeps some detail-rich records.
Pioneer Team leader had a good education.
Elena's coffee ought to be pretty good.

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: Ptilopsis has a kind of special chip implanted in her brain.

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: 'Device #9'—Mayer calls it. Guessing that's Rhine Lab's internal codename for that tech.

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: It's plugged up there directly into her nervous system. Functions as a regular part of her mind, and logs data on neural activity in each region and lobe all the while.

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: Which means you've just been looking at every last thing Ptilopsis's visual processors—her own two eyes—have been seeing.

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: Columbia's Pioneer Team members come from all backgrounds.

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: Youth dissatisfied with their lives, middle-aged couples drowning in debt, petty criminals who don't want to end up behind bars—

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: And of course, Infected powerless to cough up exorbitant insurance, who don't resign themselves to being shut away in quarantine zones for 'treatment.'

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: I'm more interested in the agrypnotic Franks has been using, personally.

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: I love a drink after work as much as the next, but all that fluid intake on the job's bound to cut up your train of thought.

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: From the logs Ptilopsis keeps synchronized with us, we can tell that along with her, there's our other Rhodes Island-partnered operator, Elena in Rhine Lab's Energy Section...

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: Along with Rhine Lab Originium Art Section's Director, Dorothy Franks. That's everyone caught up in this abduction by the Pioneers.

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: And practically simultaneously, Saria informed us Rhine Lab Ecological Section's Director Muelsyse went missing after she sent out an SOS, and there's no telling if she's currently alive or dead.

options: Think there's an issue at Rhine Lab?
Are research jobs seriously this high-risk?

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: At present, looks like it.

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: Welcome to Columbia.

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: Sky-high odds Rhine Lab is already in crisis, if things are pushing Saria to ask Rhodes Island for help.

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: Lucky the landship's nearby, or else we'd be hard-pressed to make an expeditious response.

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: The kidnapping's gone down at a new site about a hundred or so klicks out from Trimounts, but Kal'tsit's concerned this has something to do with the experiments that got shut down a while back.

options: What do they do at that site?
Originium mutation experimentation...
Tell me some more about Trimounts.

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: The stuff they show to outsiders indicates it's your typical testing grounds, currently in the middle of construction.

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: Kal'tsit's cleared us to access all relevant files before we enter Trimounts.

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: The city's the beating heart of Columbian science and technology. Hundreds of tech companies are headquartered in Trimounts.

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: The 'Diαbolic Crisis,' 'Loken Watertank,' the 'Lumberyard.'

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: Each name means something to one of our Rhodes Island operators, and behind their fronts, ties to hundreds of similar experiments.

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: Most of these experiments have involved Originium's mutative effects on living beings' cells, and each one has been incredibly dangerous.

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: In Columbia, more often than not, tech giants like Rhine Lab aren't going to participate directly in such high-risk experiments.

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: They'll have smaller-scale organizations carry them out on their behalf, hire a Pioneer Team, construct a suitable site out in the wasteland fringes of the city to execute their experimental work.

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: In this case, Ptilopsis is at Site 359, which is one of those.

options: I remember your previous work experience...
Have you done work at similar sites before?

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: Work? I'm not gracing my time there with the word 'work.'

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: Those megacorps 'plagiarized' what I created, and applied it all in places it wasn't meant to be.

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: See that billboard, about fifty meters out? 'Volvort Kochinski's Automatic Popcorn-a-Tron for the home—faster, sweeter, every time.'

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: I still have the prototype sketch for its energy core on my terminal.

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: It was supposed to be used in automatic wasteland road-cleaners at first, but my manager decided it'd never sell as a product.

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: He says, what kind of HR company's spending on better equipment for Pioneers?

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: Brought my mind to Rhodes Island after that. Our course-clearer team in Engineering's using the very latest model.

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: I've long seen it coming. Be it Volvort Kochinski or Rhine Lab, in the end, all these so-called tech firms are going to be destroyed by their own creations—

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: Because they've never respected the creations themselves.

options: What if Muelsyse got killed by her very own experiments?
It's not some horrific test subject holding Ptilopsis hostage, right?!

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: Was that a laugh line, Doctor?

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: Because what you said isn't sci-fi flick material, or a dumb joke.

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: Chances are it's tomorrow's news.

options: Now I get why Closure admires AND fears you...
No wonder you and Logos make a good team.

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: You mean her occasional stints as target practice for my new weapons?

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: She can stop interrupting my work with her ridiculous ideas, and then she won't need to fear me.

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: As a partner, Logos is pretty good.

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: But can you give him a reminder, Doctor?

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: If he could cut some of his speechcraft, mission times would go down by at least 30%, and I could spend more time on my actual job.

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: Done processing the intel, Doctor.

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: This is as much useful info as we have for now. I've already set the most important files to top priority on lookup. You can read them via PRTS at any time.

options: Any more news?

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: Ptilopsis's logs haven't been updated past this point.

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: Device #9's data transmission should be more stable ever since Mayer adjusted it.

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: So unless something physically happened to Ptilopsis...

options: I'm getting concerned for her.
Fingers crossed Silence and Greyy find her ASAP.

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: Silence will notify us of any developments at the site as they happen.

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: Saria's copied the info. She'll be rendezvousing with us in an hour.

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: Doctor, any other proposals for the time we have left?

options: Go to where Muelsyse hit trouble, take a look.

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: I'm a mechanist. I'm no detective's assistant.

options: But it's all we can do right now.
And I'm just an Originium researcher.
You're the only one I can count on, Mechanist.

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: Alright, Doctor. In that case, we move now.

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: Here's hoping I'm back on the landship by tomorrow, at my beloved workbench.
6:47 P.M. \ Overcast
Test Site 359 Observation Station, Trimounts Outskirts

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: Anything new with the people on-site?

steps.name: Rhine Defense Member
steps.text: Nothing, officer.

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: You shot word to your Director Clooney or whatever at Rhine, right? When exactly will he be here?

steps.name: Rhine Defense Member
steps.text: Director Clooney's in a... meeting right now.

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: Meeting? You're telling me he's still in a meeting? What kind of meeting's more important than his employees' lives?

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: Dammit!

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: Give me those binoculars.

steps.name: Rhine Defense Member
steps.text: Uh... okay.

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: You don't think those Pioneers are gonna follow through, do you?

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: Let me tell you—they will.

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: Push them enough, and they'll do any fricking thing.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: So you mean our colleagues at the site could be in mortal danger?

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: Who are you?

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Olivia Silence, Rhine Lab researcher, and Rhodes Island Pharmaceuticals-partnered Medic Operator.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: This is my colleague from Rhodes Island, Mr. Greyy with the Engineering Department.

steps.name: Greyy
steps.text: H-Hello! I'm a Rhodes Island electrical engineer... but I'm still interning!

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: Rhodes Island? What kind of useless crap does that company do?

steps.name: Greyy
steps.text: Er...

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: Forget it, save the explanation. One day passes in Trimounts and a barge of fresh company names unloads out of the sewers.

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: You're Rhine Lab, right? Got any pull in the office?

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Pull? Ma'am, I'm not too sure what you mean...

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: Forget it, I knew you wouldn't be in charge.

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: You strike me as one of those... eggheads-swimming-in-books types, like the hostages they've got.

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: You guys and those guys might as well live on different planets.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: I heard they were the Pioneers working at this site...

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: Pioneers.

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: The name rings too nice for anything except billboards.

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: And I know better than anyone what kind of people they are. Convicts, gamblers, Infected who can't stick the medical fees... Nothing to lose by the time they went out to the wastes.

steps.name: Greyy
steps.text: Excuse me... could we try and talk to them?

steps.name: Greyy
steps.text: You might have realized already, but Dr. Silence and I are both Infected. We're in a place to understand their situation.

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: Rhine Lab makes stupid cash, doesn't it? So does Rhodes Island or whatever?

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: You've got these, let's say 'well-intentioned,' companies paying your insurance premiums—that's the key thing.

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: That's why you can shut up about understanding them.

steps.name: Greyy
steps.text: Premiums? Which part exactly is...

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: It's the way things work here in Columbia. A policy aimed at Infected.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Ma'am, please trust us—Rhodes Island is a pharmaceutical corporation dedicated to addressing Infected issues.

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: Addressing issues? If I gave you a crossbow and told you to square away those kidnappers from here, would you do it?

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: ...I couldn't.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: I'm a doctor.

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: What about him?

steps.name: Greyy
steps.text: Me? N-No, I don't think we've reached the point where we have to resort to violence...

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: Then it looks to me like you two can't help much at all.

steps.name: Pioneer Team Member
steps.text: No sign of anyone coming, sir.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: They're playing it cool.

steps.name: Pioneer Team Member
steps.text: Say, you think the megacorps might not, uh... care if their hires die?

steps.name: Pioneer Team Member
steps.text: What with those two being Infected and all.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: Don't give me that.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: Infected aren't subhuman or nothing. At the very least, we don't wanna treat each other like that.

steps.name: Pioneer Team Member
steps.text: Alright... said that on the Pioneer recruitment ads too.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: Well, count our lucky stars the ads ain't all lies, then.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: Would you kindly drop the communicator, Dr. Urbica?

steps.name: Pioneer Team Member
steps.text: He said drop it! No funny business!

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Alright.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: I'm... I'm putting it down. Please don't hurt us.

steps.name: Pioneer Team Member
steps.text: Sir, she was sending messages!

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: Bring me those comms, Sam.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: Hmm. Only half-typed. Didn't get to send anything yet.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: These are our exact coordinates. You want them to send a drone in or something?

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: Let me give you another idea. Change this to an SOS, send it to your tutor, your manager... whoever.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: Tell them—I'm waiting. And my patience is running out.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: What exactly are you after?

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: Well that's wicked simple, doctor.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: Me and my friends here, we all just wanna leave this place alive. That's all.

steps.name: Rhine Lab Tech
steps.text: Director, finally, you're back! Can you spare a moment?
You're... Ben. Ben from Structural.

steps.name: Rhine Lab Tech
steps.text: Y-You remember my name?
Call me Ferdinand. Nine whole directors at Rhine Lab and all.

steps.name: Rhine Lab Tech
steps.text: Sir... Ferdinand.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: My next meeting is in ten minutes.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: I can spare you seven of those.

steps.name: Rhine Lab Tech
steps.text: Ahh... alright, thank you, thank you.

steps.name: Rhine Lab Tech
steps.text: Sir, do you know where Control is right now?

steps.name: Rhine Lab Tech
steps.text: I've got Structural's application for equipment purchases here. Control was supposed to give us an answer three days ago... but we haven't heard anything from her.

steps.name: Rhine Lab Tech
steps.text: Structural's having to suspend a lot of its experiments right now...

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: Give me the form.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: Alright, go procure.

steps.name: Rhine Lab Tech
steps.text: Did... Did you just sign? The handbook says large-scale equipment purchases this expensive have to go through Control...

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: How long have you been with Rhine Lab? Just a couple of months?

steps.name: Rhine Lab Tech
steps.text: Yes, sir... I reported in a month ago.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: See this site in front of you?

steps.name: Rhine Lab Tech
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: Isn't it monumental?

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: Fifteen years ago, this place was still wasteland, not even a single nomadic plate yet.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: You wouldn't see Rhine Lab on a foldout of Trimounts back in those days.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: Meet Parvis for tea, if you get the chance.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: You've got a lot to learn, Ben. And you won't find it in your handbook.

steps.name: Rhine Lab Tech
steps.text: A-Alright... Got it, sir.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: Well look at that, I still have four minutes left.
Not often you call me when it's light out, Ferdinand.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: Ho'olheyak.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: Are you done with everything I asked?

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: Mmhm... at least three empty seats for Rhine Lab's directors' meeting today?

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: No. That's not enough.

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: Oh? Which director's next?

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: Are you finally fed up with the old goat behind the chimeric organism experiments, or do you want the dreamer at the test site to never come back?

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: Word is Rhodes Island's people went to the site.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: The experiment's almost complete. I don't want anyone getting in the way before it's done, understood?

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: You want me on site?

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: No, no need for that.

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: How cruel. Your assistant's one of the hostages, isn't she? I saw that Elena girl once. She's as pretty as she is hardworking.

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: I had a feeling you'd like her.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: She's with Energy. She can wrangle the Pioneers.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: You keep an eye on developments in the city.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: It's unlikely Rhodes Island would only send two operators to the site. Don't forget, Saria's had a line to them all this time.

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: Oh? Your Defense Director again?

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: Saria's already stalled our experiments long enough... Both the Colonel and I are running short of patience.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: Remember, they can't find anything this time.

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: This is the place, Doctor.

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: The last message we got from Saria was sent from this alley.

options: Looks normal to me.
We aren't exactly near Rhine Lab HQ.
Right by the commercial sector.

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: There's hundreds of these alleys in Trimounts.

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: Here to there is about a half-hour trip by car.

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: That's the exact sector she was in.

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: She was waiting for Muelsyse. They'd agreed to meet at a specific time.

options: Seems like Muelsyse got chased here.

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: If she wasn't being pursued, she'd never choose to set foot in this alley.

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: No matter who it was, acting in the open streets would've obviously been too risky.

options: Silence told me about Muelsyse's ability.
Saria gave me a report on Muelsyse once.

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: Right... search complete.

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: 'Ability to manipulate water molecules'—would that be energy conversion-type or matter restructuring-type in terms of Originium Arts? No matter which principle it is, it's powerful at a glance.

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: 'Water molecules'—no flaws visible to the naked eye?

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: Even more interesting. Experimental research folks and us mechanists are alike. Our powers of observation are usually razor-keen.

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: If it fooled even Silence and Mayer, then it's not your ordinary Arts illusion.

options: Muelsyse wouldn't go down easy in a fight.
Muelsyse has strong self-preservation abilities.
Muelsyse is basically fight and flight in one.

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: There's a couple of scorch marks on the ground.

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: Not very wide-range... whoever did it, all signs point to some kind of technical equipment used to heat the air surrounding Muelsyse.

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: Considering her Arts are heavily dependent on water molecules, her opponent must've known her very well.

options: As well as we do.

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: You mean...

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: They might be a Rhine insider too?

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: Doctor, watch out!

options: That was close...
I was almost well-done there.

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: That was an energy weapon.

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: Shot from deep inside the alley. Enemy's only thirty meters from us, give or take.

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: And getting closer.

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: Doctor, you'll want to stay behind me.

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: Defense system active.

options: Think we're in an ambush?
Can we hold out?

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: Dr. {@nickname}, I've never seen this model of power armor before. It's new.

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: Without testing, I can't tell you exactly how destructive any weapon hooked up to this could get.

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: And by that, I mean we need a change of plans.

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: Escape system active—now get on my back!
